name: Default
shortDescription: Private X.509 certificate authority and ACME server, initialized on first start with a root, an intermediate, an admin provisioner and an ACME provisioner.

alerts.message: Clients must trust the private root certificate, served at https://<your-domain>/roots.pem. The root fingerprint is printed in the step-ca logs on first start. The generated CA_PASSWORD variable unlocks the CA keys and the admin provisioner.

TLS for your domain ends in front of the CA, so ACME clients work as-is at https://<your-domain>/acme/acme/directory. For the step CLI, run step ca renew with --mtls=false, and pass --root a bundle that trusts the domain's public certificate, because mutual TLS and the private root pin do not pass through this route.
